content.value: Find the Fourier integral of the function $f ( x ) = e ^ { - k x }$ , when $x > 0$ and $f ( - x ) { \dot { = } } - f ( x )$ (15) for $k > 0$ . And hence prove that $\int \limits _ { 0 } ^ { \infty } \frac { u \sin u x } { 1 2 + u ^ { 2 } } d u = \frac { \pi } { 2 } e ^ { - i \alpha } , k > 0$
(Answer ANY THREE questions from this section in Script B)
